item.title: Thinking Through Rollback for gridctl
item.description: I can’t count the times I dropped .terraform-version in a new Terraform repo. tfenv read it, fetched the right binary, and switched. When a new Terraform release broke a plan at the worst possible moment, tfenv use put the old one back and I went on with my day. That command has never once asked me to think hard thoughts.

item.title: Checksums Don't Prove Who Built It
item.description: For a long time, my definition of a successful software release was pretty simple: the tests passed, the binaries built, and the checksums matched. Ship it! That still sounds reasonable, but there is a gap hiding between we built some bytes and users downloaded the bytes we intended to publish.
